settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Tenant and system configuration
settings.defaultLanguageHint: Used as the fallback language for content and the UI. Saving will automatically add it to the enabled languages list.
settings.languagesDesc: Choose which languages editors can assign to content. At least one must be selected. These appear in the language selector when creating or editing items.
settings.pluginsDesc: Install a plugin to provision its system collections (e.g. <mono>website_pages</mono>, <mono>blog_posts</mono>). Already-present collections are skipped. Install is idempotent.
settings.noPlugins: No plugins are available for this tenant.
settings.inheritDesc: Use the server's default S3 (<mono>{{bucket}}</mono>). Files are stored under <mono>tenants/{tenant_id}/…</mono>.
settings.noDefaultS3: No default S3 is configured on the server — enter this tenant's own credentials below.
